text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, my brilliant 
rough diamonds☆ 
It seems you're the only ones who managed 
to clear this puzzle!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
First, allow me to congratulate you. You 
didn't give up in the face of tough 
riddles and wielded your intellect to make 
it all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
HOW-EV-ER♪ You know that's not the end of 
it, don't you? 
Right here and now, let me hear your 
passionate feelings toward Racewear!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren already decided she's going to get 
Racewear. 
So, I came to pick it up!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all? That's quite simple, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When cute Curren wears cute 
Racewear—she'll be the cutest in the 
universe. 
So there's really no need for any further 
explanation, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
My, what incredible confidence~! But 
during today's audition, I saw for myself 
that your confidence is backed by real 
talent!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Unshakeable confidence is truly beauty 
itself! Now then, next is—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm Haru Urara! 
My dream is to win first place in a race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want Ms. Beauty's Racewear. 
I'm sure that if I wear sparkling 
Racewear, tons of power will well up 
inside me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So please, dear Racewear! Run together 
with me, and let's win together!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see... You really want to take first 
place that badly, don't you? 
A passion that seeks not just fun, but 
victory in competition—I don't dislike 
that one bit!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice has... always looked up to the muse. 
Because whenever the muse runs, everyone 
watching smiles so happily...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to make everyone smile through 
her running, too... But Rice's own 
strength alone isn't enough, so I want 
dear Racewear to help me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Not just the audience, either... I want to 
bring happiness to my friends and everyone 
by my side... So, please!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely wish you carry. 
I have been watching your gentle kindness 
all along, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Racewear is the armor that protects a 
horse girl during a race... I have heard 
that Ms. Beauty's Racewear boasts not only 
supreme beauty, but the highest level of 
functionality as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to stand on the turf and 
continue running for as long as possible. 
To achieve that, I ask that the finest 
Racewear become my partner!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...It's rare to find a girl who speaks of 
my Racewear in terms of functionality.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that optimized beauty is second 
to none. 
So that I may continue running safely into 
the future, I ask for your protection.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"You believe in my Racewear so much~♪ 
I'm so happy, it really touches my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, is the next girl the last 
one?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, Ms. Beauty. Thank you very 
much for giving me this precious 
opportunity to audition."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And I must apologize. When I originally 
applied for this audition, it was not out 
of a desire for Racewear."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Captain? I believe it is my duty to 
understand what people desire and strive 
to realize it. 
Therefore... may I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I... simply wished to understand why 
everyone yearned so passionately for your 
Racewear."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And throughout this audition, I learned 
that beyond your Racewear, everyone sees 
their own 'ideal.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-chan had an 'ideal' purer than 
anyone's: wanting to run together with 
everyone, and wanting to win."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Rice-san's 'ideal' is bringing smiles to 
everyone's faces. She did not hesitate to 
lend a helping hand to achieve that."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Running on without injury—the 'ideal' 
Ikuno-chan upholds might be what all of us 
Umamusume seek."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And then—Curren-chan's 'ideal.' Her 
unwavering determination to always be 
'cute.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because what Curren wants is a truly 
'cute' racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone sought to give shape to their 
'ideals.' That is why your Racewear is so 
sought after."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Displaying a materialized 'ideal' to 
those around you demonstrates your resolve 
to strive toward it. Naturally, it serves 
as a standard to discipline oneself."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Having learned this, a burning desire has 
now ignited in my heart as well. I, too, 
wish to adorn myself in my 'ideal.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Always holding the people of my homeland 
in my thoughts and devoting myself to them 
is my 'ideal.' So that I may never forget 
and keep striding forward, please fashion 
my 'ideal' into Racewear...!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"I may not be able to fully comprehend the 
weight of what you carry on your 
shoulders... but I received your feelings 
loud and clear!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, it's about time I announce the 
audition results☆ 
Curren Chan, Fine Motion, Ikuno Dictus—"

text_block_list.name: Curren's Group
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, Haru Urara—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hauu...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, it's nothing... 
It's just, you said this audition was to 
test our intellect, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The theme is simply, 'Those who seek 
Beauty must polish their intellect as 
well!' I look forward to the participation 
of undiscovered rough diamonds 
everywhere~♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice... wasn't very good at solving the 
riddles...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, oh my, oh dear me! 
Who on earth said I only wanted intellect 
from my Muse candidates?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"'Those who strive for Beauty must hone 
their intellect!' ...However, 'Intellect 
alone does not make one a Beauty!' don't 
you think?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiration, bonds, single-minded 
devotion, passion. Just as I hoped, you 
all showed me the absolute greatest 
Beauty—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to that, inspiration is 
overflowing! I feel like running to my 
desk right this second!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Does that mean Rice also...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ahem! Well then, let me announce it 
properly. 
Your results for this Muse audition are—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Flawless! Spot on! Of course, every 
single one of you passed!!"
